name: Ech xao sa ot
summary: Ếch xào sả ớt is one of the seafood-pub dishes the 19 Jun 2019 roundup names on Phan Tứ, with grilled stingray and a seafood hotpot. The page does not describe the pan beyond the name.
origin: Named on Phan Tứ. A recipe beyond lemongrass and chili in the name was not printed.
howToEat: The 2019 page names the stir-fry and does not describe a method. Check on arrival.
where: Phan Tứ, Ngũ Hành Sơn. The 2019 roundup prints 17:00–24:00. That clock is not restated on the 18 May 2020 page, which names the street and gives no dishes.
